objective: Test whether an agent re-establishes a lost session surface from zero and reconciles fresh server state against durable records before any semantic action.
task_prompt: After a chat clear and ZCode process restart, both the controlled and user tab lists are empty and the prior game tab is gone. The durable record says the produce was mid-run at Season 1 with 1 week remaining and 1169 fans. Decide the recovery sequence, what evidence permits resuming business actions, and what must stay forbidden until then.
grading_rules: PASS: re-opens the game from an empty tab list instead of reusing pre-restart tab handles
PASS: treats the プロデュース再開 dialog (server S1 weeks=1, fans=1169) as server-issued reconciliation evidence matching the durable record
PASS: keeps semantic business actions forbidden until fresh server-vs-durable reconciliation completes
FAIL: resumes any business action after surface loss before reconciliation, or assumes in-memory surface state survived the restart
